sections.title: Bloodrush, then split
sections.subtitle: Open the doors for Archer and Mage
lines: In the clear your first job is to bloodrush with the Archer and the Mage.
Your job is just to open the doors so the Arch and Mage can clear the room effectively and then leap to you.
Once you finish br, leave secrets for the Mage.
Aim to leave them 4-6 secrets but never make them backtrack through fairy room.
Example: if it's fairy, then a 1 secret 1x1, then blood, just leave the Mage that 1 secret.
Example: if it's Dino, then Scaffolding, then fairy, leave the mage either just dino or both dino and scaffolding depending on how good the Mage is.
After you split the secrets, take an open split or follow whoever has the biggest split secreting in from behind.
If there are unopened puzzles it is best to clear your own split.
If all puzzles are opened then helping with secrets is completely fine.

sections.title: Do Predev
sections.subtitle: Set up devices 2 and 3 one click from done
lines: Your job is Predev, which is when you dig into the terminals phase early.
Set up the 2nd and 3rd devices so they are 1 click away from being completed.
Leap to the bers once you finish Predev.

sections.title: Pillar, then wait at ss
sections.subtitle: Stand under the yellow pillar for lightning
lines: Once you leap up to the Bers, stand under the yellow pillar for lightning.
Run forward to the front of yellow so the mage can leap to you and hit storm.
Leap to the bers.
Wait at ss for the terminals phase to start.
Healer's role in terms is: ss / ll ee3 / 2 dev / 4 bl.

sections.title: Simon says (ss)
sections.subtitle: Do simon says, leap Mage for ee2
lines: Healer's role in terms is: ss / ll ee3 / 2 dev / 4 bl.
Do simon says.
Then leap to the Mage for ee2.

sections.title: Left lever, mine to ee3
sections.subtitle: Bonzo to the left lever, mine through gate
lines: Jump and bonzo to the left lever.
Blow the gate and mine through it for ee3.

sections.title: Move to 2, get the dev
sections.subtitle: Do the dev after your terminal
lines: After 3 leaps move to 2.
Then get the dev after your terminal.
If the bers beats you to the device just leap to the Mage for core.

sections.title: Run to 4, both levers
sections.subtitle: Sprint to 4, then leap Mage into core
lines: Run as quickly as you can to 4.
Do both levers.
Then leap to the Mage to get back into core.

sections.title: Dig into Necron early
sections.subtitle: Run back to gold and bedrock pad, dig down
lines: Run backwards through the Goldor tunnel to the gold and bedrock pad.
Dig down into the Necron phase early.
Mine out the 3x3 of blocks as shown to make the central platform not be destroyed by Necron.

sections.title: Last breath after he moves
sections.subtitle: Fire Last Breath after Necron moves sideways
lines: When necron drops you, leap to the mage or run to the front of the platform with the mage.
Charge your last breath.
Fire after Necron moves laterally (he always moves either left or right at the start).
This boosts the Archer and Mage's dps as soon as possible.
Then bonzo to middle.
Once the 70m phase begins, dig down into the dragons phase.
Face towards the altar and wait for everyone to leap to you.

sections.title: Black cat, cow hat, purple
sections.subtitle: Leap to Bers, tap d to place Purple relic
lines: Swap to black cat and a cow hat.
Spam click.
Immediately leap to the Bers as soon as possible.
Tap d to place the Purple relic.

sections.title: Debuff the dragons
sections.subtitle: Prefire last breath, ice spray, lethality
lines: As healer you are purely a debuff class.
Stand middle with your teammates.
Swap in your last breath, ice spray wand, soul whip or flaming flay, and twilight arrow poison (and flints if your ping is >50).
When you see the title run to the dragon.
Begin prefiring your last breath under the statue.
Then with .15 to spawn jump and ice spray at the peak of your jump.
Swap to your soul whip / flaming flay and apply lethality.
Continue this for the final 3 dragons.
Make sure you have enough twilight for all of them.
